# proxmox_sdn_prefix_lists (Data Source)

Lists staged SDN prefix lists from `/cluster/sdn/prefix-lists`, sorted by `prefix_list_id`. Entries are Proxmox property strings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_sdn_prefix_lists" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this data source call.
- `prefix_lists` (Attributes List) All prefix lists, sorted by `prefix_list_id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prefix_lists))

<a id="nestedatt--prefix_lists"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prefix_lists`

Read-Only:

- `entries` (List of String)
- `pending` (Map of String)
- `prefix_list_id` (String)
- `state` (String)
